positive.point: Some users appreciate the ability to verify identity quickly and continue dashing without issues.
The ROCKEY MONEY app is recommended for canceling subscriptions easily.

negative.point: Users experience difficulties with DoorDash support, including inability to reach them and unhelpful responses.
Recurring issues with identity verification, causing frustration among users.
Problems with payment methods being denied or requiring unnecessary verification.
Users face challenges with account deactivation and unresolved financial issues.
Technical glitches in the app, such as errors in scheduling and navigation, are common.
Difficulty in canceling DashPass subscriptions, leading to unauthorized charges.
